verdict.rationale: Insomnia's import docs list OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 and Swagger as supported import formats. They also document the flow for importing an OpenAPI spec (UI → Import → File/Clipboard/URL), which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an imported spec is turned into individual requests organized as a collection (folder/request mapping), and independent or hands-on confirmation of import fidelity.
